title: No Social Interaction Screens
description: Instantly closes all social interaction screens if you have them open. (I can't just remove them entirely, since I made this in MCreator.)
body:
This mod will instantly close all social interaction screens that you'd happen to have open. 

Since this is a simple MCreator mod, it just closes them instead of completely removing them from the game.

Although I'd prefer them completely gone, this will have to do for now. Maybe you can use it in combination with other mods for a better effect? Who knows.

At the very least, just think of it as doing something Mojang/Microsoft doesn't want you to do.

Here is every screen that closes if it is detected to be open:
 - "Chat Report"
 - "Chat Selection"
 - "Report Reason Selection"
 - "Social Interactions"

This also runs on the server as well, just for good measure.
